Class Polyline

Namespace
ShapeEngine.Geometry.PolylineDef
Assembly
ShapeEngine.dll

Represents a polyline, which is a series of connected points in 2D space. Provides methods for geometric operations and shape conversions.

Remarks

Points should be provided in counter-clockwise (CCW) order for correct geometric behavior. Use the ReverseOrder() method if your points are in clockwise (CW) order.

GetClosestPoint(Circle)

Finds the closest point between this polyline and a Circle.

public ClosestPointResult GetClosestPoint(Circle other)

Parameters

other Circle

The Circle to compare against.

Returns

ClosestPointResult

A ClosestPointResult containing the closest points and related data. Returns a default value if the polyline has fewer than two points.

Remarks

This method iterates through each segment of the polyline and finds the closest point on each segment to the circle. The closest of these is returned as a ClosestPointResult.

GetEdges()

Returns the segments (edges) of the polyline as a Segments collection. If the points are in counter-clockwise (CCW) order, the segment normals face to the right of the segment direction. If InsideNormals is true, the normals face to the left of the segment direction.

Computes the intersection points between this polyline and another collider's shape.

public IntersectionPoints? Intersect(Collider collider)

Parameters

collider Collider

The collider whose shape will be tested for intersection with this polyline.

Returns

IntersectionPoints

A IntersectionPoints object containing intersection points, or null if there are no intersections or the collider is disabled.

Remarks

The method dispatches to the appropriate intersection routine based on the collider's shape type.

Intersect(Collider, ref IntersectionPoints, bool)

Computes the intersection points between this polyline and another collider's shape, storing results in a provided IntersectionPoints collection.

public int Intersect(Collider collider, ref IntersectionPoints points, bool returnAfterFirstValid = false)

Parameters

collider Collider

The collider whose shape will be tested for intersection with this polyline.

points IntersectionPoints

A reference to a IntersectionPoints collection where intersection points will be stored.

returnAfterFirstValid bool

If true, the method returns after finding the first valid intersection; otherwise, it finds all intersections.

Returns

int

The number of intersection points found.

Remarks

The method dispatches to the appropriate intersection routine based on the collider's shape type. This overload allows for efficient accumulation of results.

ReverseOrder()

Reverses the order of points in the polyline. After calling this method, the polyline will be in clockwise (CW) order if it was counter-clockwise (CCW) before and vice versa.

public void ReverseOrder()

ScaleSize(float)

Scales the polyline uniformly about its centroid.

public void ScaleSize(float scale)

Parameters

scale float

The scale factor to apply to all points relative to the centroid.

Remarks

A scale of 1 leaves the polyline unchanged; values greater than 1 enlarge it, and values between 0 and 1 shrink it.

Returns

Polyline

Remarks

The original polyline is not modified.

Remarks

All points are set to be exactly size units from the centroid, preserving their directions.
